mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Fireman's Park with a current temperature of 78 degrees. Tonight, the low will drop to 71 with no rain in the forecast. If you are looking to the stars, the International Space Station will be visible tonight at 9:37 PM, traveling from over Cross Plains toward Oregon and reaching about halfway up the sky.

In city news, the sticker design contest for our November election is now moving to the next phase. While entries are closed, the community will be able to vote for the best K-12 designs between July 28 and August 7. Also, please remember to check your mailboxes and ensure they are compliant with city standards to avoid damage during the upcoming plow season.

There is plenty to do around town. Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, or the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, we have yoga at Insight Wellness on July 27, and don't miss trivia and the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market on July 29.
In a look at our weekly police report, officers responded to a call on July 13 regarding a vehicle stuck on a large rock, resulting in an arrest for an O-W-I.
For dessert tonight, the Culver's flavor of the day is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. They are currently open and will be serving until 10:30 PM, so there is still plenty of time to grab a scoop.
